profile.name: Ivan Lara
profile.headline: UI & Full-Stack Developer
profile.summary: Frontend-leaning UI and Full-Stack Developer with over 10 years of experience building scalable web applications, from early-stage products to enterprise SaaS platforms. Specialized in React, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, Java, and C#, with a focus on user experience, performance, and maintainable architecture.

highlights.text: Supported digital product delivery for high-traffic custom/private e-commerce platforms using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and Angular, partnering with product, design, backend, and QA teams to clarify requirements and deliver production-ready features.

Participated in backlog refinement, sprint planning, Jira ticket discussions, and technical conversations, helping translate business requirements into actionable frontend, API, and integration tasks.

Developed and integrated RESTful APIs with Node.js to support critical e-commerce workflows, including cart management, checkout, order processing, account features, and customer-facing transactional flows.

Partnered with engineering teams on API-related initiatives, integration flows, and orchestration-layer capabilities to improve communication between frontend applications, backend services, and third-party systems.

Integrated Contentful’s GraphQL API to dynamically fetch and render structured content for public landing pages, supporting a scalable CMS-driven architecture and reducing dependency on hardcoded marketing content.

Built and maintained Angular v20 features for a production web platform, including responsive UI components, video API integrations, authentication flows, playback/stream workflows, event handling, and error states.

Helped investigate and resolve production issues across frontend, API, and integration layers, coordinating with technical teams to identify root causes, validate fixes, and support timely resolution.
Unified client/server validation using TypeScript generics and Zod, reducing duplicated interfaces, improving type safety, and helping teams ship features with fewer validation-related issues.

Improved shared-state management across complex UI flows by implementing scalable Zustand-based architecture with a Provider pattern, reducing prop drilling and making component behavior more predictable.

Led the creation and accessibility enhancement of a scalable UI Kit based on Atomic Design principles, translating Figma designs into reusable, theme-ready components aligned with WCAG guidelines and validating screen-reader behavior with VoiceOver on macOS, improving design consistency and accelerating development across multiple projects.

Adopted Claude Code and custom AI-assisted workflows to improve codebase exploration, accessibility review, documentation, and developer productivity while collaborating with designers, backend engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
